# PlayClock

**PlayClock** is a client-side Fabric mod that tracks your Minecraft playtime directly inside the game. It shows how long you have played on each multiplayer server or singleplayer world, including today’s playtime, total time, current session time, and last played information.

Whether you play on SMP servers, local worlds, LAN worlds, or direct connect servers, PlayClock gives you a clean way to monitor your Minecraft activity without commands, external tools, or server-side plugins. It also includes shareable playtime cards, weekly/monthly recaps, an in-game HUD, menu markers, hover tooltips, and deep Mod Menu customization.

## Features

- Tracks playtime for multiplayer servers and singleplayer worlds
- Shows today, total, session, and last played stats
- Reliable singleplayer saving when playing, leaving a world, or closing the client
- Clean in-game HUD with multiple layout styles
- Playtime markers in server and world lists
- Hover tooltips with detailed time information
- Header summary in list screens
- Shareable per-server and per-world playtime cards
- Weekly and monthly recap cards with charts, streaks, active days, and top target stats
- Copy cards to clipboard or save them as PNG
- Hotkeys to quickly toggle HUD, menu markers, summary screen, and HUD editor
- Mod Menu settings screen
- Custom UI colors, presets, RGB and HEX editing
- Custom card accent colors with 10 presets
- Supports English, Russian, and Ukrainian
- Stores all data locally in JSON
- Fully client-side — no server installation required

## Why Use PlayClock?

Minecraft does not clearly show how much time you spend on each server or world. PlayClock fixes that by adding a clean playtime tracker directly into the menus, HUD, and summary screens you already use.

It is useful for players who want to track SMP activity, compare time spent across worlds, monitor current sessions, review weekly or monthly play habits, share recap cards, or simply keep a better overview of their Minecraft playtime.

## Supported Versions

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Minecraft 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2

## Notes

PlayClock is client-side only. Your playtime data is stored locally on your device. Realms are not supported in the current release.
